name: Cabbage and Sausage Fried Rice
summary: Fried rice bulked out with shredded cabbage and smoked sausage.
instructions: Cook the rice ahead and chill it, or use leftover rice — cold rice fries best.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Scramble the eggs until just set, then scoop out.
Add the remaining oil and the diced sausage. Cook 3–4 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic and cabbage and stir-fry 5–6 minutes until the cabbage wilts.
Add the cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3 minutes. Return the eggs, add the soy sauce, and toss.
Top with green onions and serve.

glutenFree.notes: Use tamari instead of soy sauce and a certified gluten-free sausage to make the dish gluten-free.

budgetNotes: A great use for leftover rice and half a cabbage.
Any smoked sausage or even hot dogs work here.
Add a splash of sesame oil at the end if you keep it on hand.
